create_vision_tower: create a VisionTower module with a backbone, frozen settings, and configurable head blocks for vision feature extraction
build_vision_head: build a VisionHead module with attention blocks, layer normalization, and linear projection for processing image tokens
init_weights_vit_timm: init ViT module weights using timm-style truncated normal initialization for linear, layernorm, and conv layers
named_apply_fn: apply a function recursively to all named child modules of a PyTorch module with depth-first traversal
extract_backbone_features: extract class tokens, patch tokens, and register tokens from a DINOv2 backbone using intermediate layer outputs
